title: Horizontal Bamboo Sticks
description: A simple datapack for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.4 that adds an alternative recipe for crafting sticks from bamboo.
body:
Features
Adds a new horizontal crafting recipe:
2 Bamboo → 1 Stick
Does not remove or modify any vanilla recipes.
Lightweight and multiplayer-friendly.
Works with existing worlds.
Recipe

[Bamboo] [Bamboo] → Stick

Compatibility
Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.4
Datapack only (no mods required)
Why?

In vanilla Minecraft, bamboo can be crafted into sticks only when placed vertically. This datapack adds a horizontal recipe for players who prefer a more intuitive crafting layout and improved quality of life.

Installation
Download the datapack.
Place the ZIP file in your world's datapacks folder.
Run /reload or re-enter the world.
Enjoy the new recipe!

Made for players who want small quality-of-life improvements without changing vanilla gameplay.
